Flag unusual achievement level transitions

Source: R/01_trend_transitions.R
flag_transitions.Rd

Compares each subject x grade x year pair with the same subject and grade's other year pairs. For each rate (up, stable, down) and each from-to level share, the difference from the other years' average is divided by the standard deviation of such differences across all subjects and grades, and differences beyond flag_sd are flagged. Comparing within subject and grade keeps stable differences between grades from being flagged every year; pooling the standard deviation keeps the test usable with only a few year pairs.

Usage

flag_transitions(transition_data, assessment_spec, flag_sd = 1.5)

Arguments

transition_data

Named list returned by compute_transitions().

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

flag_sd

Numeric. Standard deviation threshold for flagging. Default 1.5.

Value

A named list:

  • $table — flagged subject x grade x year pairs, with observed (pct_*) and typical (typical_*) rates, z-scores, and annotations

  • $table_cells — flagged from-to level shares; mean_prop is the typical share in the same subject and grade's other year pairs

  • $narrative — markdown summary naming the largest flags
